name: Transcendent Power [Metapsionic]
body:
Your psionic abilities cross over into the realm of magic.

Benefit(s): To use this feat, a character must expend their psionic focus. The power manifested using this feat is treated as a magic spell of no particular school for all purposes (feats, class abilities area effects, spell resistance, etc.). This does not allow metamagic feats to be applied to the power. Manifesting a Transcendent power costs 2 additional power points, and the total cost cannot exceed the character’s manifester level.
